description: Local artifact ignore contract. Generated reports, local teaching-package exports, local stores, caches, and real secret files must stay out of version control.

ignoredArtifacts.reason: Real local environment files may contain API keys, tokens, passwords, or private endpoints.
Environment variants must stay local; .env.example is explicitly allowed as a safe template.
The default CLI store is local Mock state and can contain reviewer names, paths, and generated task snapshots.
Custom CLI Mock stores should not be committed.
Phase 1 workflow, grading, and delivery reports are reproducible local outputs.
Phase 1 acceptance reports are reproducible local Markdown outputs.
Review-approved teaching-package ZIP exports are reproducible local outputs and may contain teacher-only Exam answers and Grading rules.
Local delivery package archives should be regenerated instead of committed.
Local logs can include paths or operational details.
Temporary files are not source artifacts.
Editor backup files are not source artifacts.
